faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about GiftHub

groupon.question: How is this different from Groupon?
groupon.answer: Groupon-style deal sites typically keep a large share of each sale and own the customer relationship. We charge a flat monthly fee (from {price}/mo) plus {percent}% on voucher sales. You keep your customers, your data, and your margins.

referral.question: How does the referral system work?
referral.answer: Every customer who buys a voucher gets a unique referral link. When they share it and a friend purchases, both earn credit. Each referral chain is tracked so you see exactly how new customers find you.

trial.question: What happens after the {days}-day trial?
trial.answer: You choose a plan ({starter}, {pro}, or {scale}). If you don’t subscribe, your existing published vouchers stay active for customers, but you can’t create new campaigns until you subscribe.

qr.question: Do I need special hardware for QR redemption?
qr.answer: No. Your staff opens the mobile scanner on any phone browser, scans the customer’s QR code, and it’s done. No app download, no POS integration required.

fee.question: What is the {percent}% transaction fee?
fee.answer: When a customer purchases a voucher through the platform, we deduct {percent}% from the payout. There are no other platform fees on top of your plan.

faq.metaDescription: Answers to common questions about buying, redeeming, and managing vouchers and gift cards — payments, refunds, expiry, and merchant support.
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our platform.

whatIs.a: GiftHub is a digital voucher, gift card, and event ticket marketplace that connects merchants with customers. Merchants can create and sell digital products, and customers can purchase, gift, and redeem them.

isFree.q: Is the platform free to use?
isFree.a: Browsing and creating an account is free. Customers pay only for the products they purchase. Merchants pay a monthly plan plus a {fee}% transaction fee on voucher sales.

countries.a: We support merchants and customers across the EU, with {currencies} currencies and {languages} languages.

howToBuy.q: How do I buy a voucher?
howToBuy.a: Browse available vouchers, click "Buy", and complete checkout via Stripe. Your voucher will appear in your wallet immediately after payment.

paymentMethods.a: Payments are processed securely by Stripe. The payment methods available for your purchase are shown at checkout.

refund.a: Refund policies are set by individual merchants. Check the voucher details page for the specific refund policy before purchasing.

howToRedeem.q: How do I redeem a voucher?
howToRedeem.a: Open your wallet, select the voucher, and show the QR code to the merchant. They will scan it to confirm redemption. You can also redeem by entering a code manually.

expiry.q: What happens when a voucher expires?
expiry.a: Expired vouchers cannot be redeemed. You will receive a notification before expiration. Check your wallet for expiry dates.

gift.q: Can I gift a voucher to someone?
gift.a: Yes! When purchasing, select "Send as gift" and enter the recipient's email. They will receive the voucher with a personalized message.

twoFactor.q: How do I enable two-factor authentication?
twoFactor.a: Go to Settings → Security → Two-Factor Authentication. You can set up TOTP (Google Authenticator) or use passkey (biometric) authentication.

biometrics.q: Can I sign in with biometrics?
biometrics.a: Yes! We support Passkey authentication — sign in with Face ID, fingerprint, or Windows Hello. Set it up in Settings → Security.

deleteAccount.q: How do I delete my account?
deleteAccount.a: Go to Settings → Privacy → Delete Account. All your data will be erased within 30 days per our GDPR compliance policy. You can export your data first.

startSelling.a: Register as a merchant, complete the onboarding process, and create your first voucher. You can start selling immediately after profile approval.

fees.a: After a {trialDays}-day free trial, plans cost {starter} {starterPrice}, {pro} {proPrice} or {scale} {scalePrice} per month (annual billing: 2 months free), plus a {fee}% transaction fee on voucher sales, deducted from the payout.

integrations.q: Can I integrate with my existing systems?
integrations.a: Yes! We offer webhooks (for real-time event notifications), API keys (for programmatic access), and Zapier/Slack/Discord integrations.

trackSales.q: How do I track my sales?
trackSales.a: Your merchant dashboard shows real-time analytics including revenue, redemptions, customer insights, and AI-powered natural language queries ("show me last week's revenue").

loyalty.q: How does the loyalty program work?
loyalty.a: Earn points by making purchases, daily check-ins, referrals, and writing reviews. Points unlock tier levels (Bronze → Silver → Gold → Platinum → Diamond) with increasing benefits.

badges.a: Badges are achievements earned for milestones (first purchase, 10 referrals, etc.). Streaks track consecutive days of activity and reward consistency.
